capabilities: Store each calendar event as a separate note with frontmatter
Render a calendar view of events inside the vault
Pull events from note frontmatter and daily note event lists
Subscribe to read-only remote ICS and CalDAV calendars
Link events freely to tasks and other notes
extras: Remote ICS and CalDAV calendars are read-only; full documentation lives outside the README at an external link.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar, so schedules and events live outside the vault and cannot be linked to notes and tasks.

relations.evidence: This plugin integrates the FullCalendar library into your Obsidian Vault

summary: Calendar plugin that stores each event as a note with frontmatter and renders a FullCalendar view inside the vault.
